name: Honeypots: Amusing Fakes (d10)
description: Knowledge (engineering) result of 60 or lower with a natural 1–10. Celmak laughs, and the ratings rise by 1.

results.description: The schematic is a beautifully drafted diagram of a duck, labelled “PRIMARY POWER SOURCE.”

results.description: The exit is through the door marked EXIT. There is no door marked EXIT. A moment later, there is; it opens onto a wall painted with a door.
